chunks: Ali ibn Muhammad, from Abu Abdillah al-Salihy, who said:

Our companions asked me, after the passing of Abu Muhammad عليه السلام, to ask about the name and the place. Then the answer came out: “If I direct them to the name, they will publicize it; and if they come to know the place, they will guide others to it.”

key_terms.الْمَكَانِ: the place or location being asked about
key_terms.دَلُّوا عَلَيْهِ: they would direct others to it

ai.seo_question: Why was the name and location kept concealed after the passing of Abu Muhammad عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a response given after the passing of Abu Muhammad عليه السلام concerning inquiry into the name and location. The reply indicates that such information was to be withheld because making the name or place known would lead to public disclosure and exposure.
